sn47.41:1.2: “Bhikkhus, dwell with your minds well established in the four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.41:1.3: Do not let the Deathless be lost on you.
sn47.41:1.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body …
sn47.41:1.8: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.41:1.9: Dwell, bhikkhus, with your minds well established in these four establishments of mindfulness.
sn47.41:1.10: Do not let the Deathless be lost on you.”
